sentences.text: Sam er hos Marta klokka fem om morgenen. Han vil se hvordan hun baker brød.
sentences.english: Sam is at Marta's at five o'clock in the morning. He wants to see how she bakes bread.

sentences.text: Hva trenger du til brød, Marta?
sentences.english: What do you need for bread, Marta?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jeg trenger mel, vann, salt og gjær. Det er alt.
sentences.english: I need flour, water, salt and yeast. That is all.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Det er ikke mye!
sentences.english: That is not much!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Nei, men det må gjøres riktig. Se på meg.
sentences.english: No, but it must be done right. Watch me.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Først tar Marta mel. Hun tar vann og salt og gjær også. Så lager hun deig.
sentences.english: First Marta takes flour. She takes water and salt and yeast too. Then she makes dough.

sentences.text: Deigen må hvile. Den hviler lenge, og den blir stor.
sentences.english: The dough must rest. It rests for a long time, and it gets big.

sentences.text: Hvor lenge må deigen hvile?
sentences.english: How long must the dough rest?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Lenge. Hvis du ikke venter, blir brødet dårlig.
sentences.english: A long time. If you do not wait, the bread will be bad.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Etterpå lager hun små brød av deigen. Hun setter dem i ovnen.
sentences.english: Afterwards she makes small loaves from the dough. She puts them in the oven.

sentences.text: Ovnen er varm. Etter litt lukter det godt, og brødet blir ferdig.
sentences.english: The oven is hot. After a little while it smells good, and the bread is done.

sentences.text: Nå er brødet ferdig. Smak!
sentences.english: Now the bread is done. Taste!
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Det er veldig godt! Jeg liker brød som er varmt.
sentences.english: It is very good! I like bread that is warm.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Du kan lage det selv, Sam. Du trenger mel, vann, salt og gjær.
sentences.english: You can make it yourself, Sam. You need flour, water, salt and yeast.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Og deig, ovn og tid. Jeg skal prøve hjemme!
sentences.english: And dough, oven and time. I will try at home!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Neste dag baker Sam brød hjemme hos Anna. Det blir ikke så bra, men alle spiser det.
sentences.english: The next day Sam bakes bread at Anna's. It does not turn out so well, but everyone eats it.

sentences.text: Det er godt, Sam! Du må lære av Marta.
sentences.english: It is good, Sam! You must learn from Marta.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Jeg skal komme hver lørdag og lære. Er det bra for deg?
sentences.english: I will come every Saturday and learn. Is that good for you?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ja, det er veldig bra. Jeg er gammel, og jeg liker å ha deg her.
sentences.english: Yes, that is very good. I am old, and I like having you here.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Hver lørdag står Sam opp tidlig. Han går til Marta, og de baker brød.
sentences.english: Every Saturday Sam gets up early. He goes to Marta, and they bake bread.

sentences.text: Folk på markedet liker brødet. De spør: «Hvem baker så godt brød?» Marta sier: «Det er Sam og jeg!»
sentences.english: People at the market like the bread. They ask: "Who bakes such good bread?" Marta says: "It is Sam and I!"

sentences.text: Nyheten sier at de bygger en ny skole. Ola sier at det blir mer plass der. Sam vil gå dit og lære.
sentences.english: The news says that they are building a new school. Ola says that there will be more room there. Sam wants to go there and learn.

sentences.text: Jenta svarte på gåten. Hun var klok. Ingen hadde svart før, og hun var ikke redd for trollet.
sentences.english: The girl answered the riddle. She was clever. Nobody had answered before, and she was not afraid of the troll.

sentences.text: På skolen lærer vi begge: bokmål og nynorsk. Dialektene er forskjellige, men vi forstår hverandre.
sentences.english: At school we learn both: Bokmål and Nynorsk. The dialects are different, but we understand each other.

sentences.text: Toget går langt, gjennom en tunnel. En dame går ut igjen.
sentences.english: The train goes far, through a tunnel. A woman gets off again.

sentences.text: Er du sikker på at brødet er ferdig?
sentences.english: Are you sure that the bread is ready?

sentences.text: Ingrid stoppet på brua. «Stopp!» sa trollet.
sentences.english: Ingrid stopped on the bridge. "Stop!" said the troll.
